confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Watch AirPlay activity on {name} ({host})? This adds one sensor that turns on while something is streaming to it.

user.title: AirPort Express
user.description: Enter the Express to watch. The IP address is used for the /info cross-check, so give it a DHCP reservation. The mDNS name is how it appears in AirPlay - matching on it survives an address change.

error.need_host_or_name: Enter an IP address, an mDNS name, or both.

abort.already_configured: This AirPort Express is already set up.

init.title: AirPlay activity settings
init.description: The off delay stops brief AirPlay handshake blips flapping the sensor. Keep it short: a longer 'has the music really stopped' wait belongs in your automation, where you can see it.
